subject: Operator simulation window + staging validation plan for on-prem deployment
messages:
From: Kate Alvarez <kate@echelonhealth.com>

Cc: supply@procureops.com
Date: 2027-08-24T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: operator simulation window + acceptance criteria for staging validation

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the demo last week. As we move toward procurement sign-off, the SRE and Compliance teams at Echelon need a short-run operator simulation and a clear staging validation checklist for the on-prem (VPC + air-gapped) deployment. Specifically we need:  

- A 2–3 hour simulated maintenance window scenario that includes operator logins, KMS rotation, patch delivery via offline media, and DB snapshot/restore verification.
- A pass/fail checklist that maps to our SOC-2 and internal change control requirements (operator separation, egress gating, telemetry offload).
- A proposed calendar window for the simulation (week of Sept 13 preferred).

Can you send a draft simulation plan and proposed owners by Wednesday? ProcureOps is tracking schedule and will need the runbook to finalize purchase order dates.

Best,
Kate
Director, IT Operations
Echelon HealthTech
From: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: operator simulation window + acceptance criteria for staging validation

Hi Kate — thanks, and congrats on moving this forward.

We can provide a focused 3-hour operator simulation that covers the scenarios you listed. High level:

- Simulation goals: exercise operator procedures, validate KMS/HSM handoff and rotation, verify offline patching via air-gapped media, and confirm telemetry gating to an internal collector (no egress).
- Redwood leads: Ben Carter (On-prem Engineer) will own the run execution, Laura Bennett (Systems Reliability) will own acceptance criteria mapping to our controls, and Vanessa Ortiz (Customer Success — Deployables) will handle scheduling and operator coordination.
- Deliverables by Sept 1: PDF runbook (operator_sim_plan_v1.pdf), an XLSX checklist mapping to SOC2/Control IDs (staging-validation-checklist.xlsx), and a network diagram snapshot (redwood-onprem-network-diagram.png).

Proposed simulation windows (all US-PST):
1) Mon 2027-09-13 10:00–13:00
2) Tue 2027-09-14 14:00–17:00
3) Thu 2027-09-16 08:00–11:00

Please confirm preferred slot and whether Echelon will provide a locked staging subnet with operator accounts pre-provisioned, or whether Redwood should create temporary operator accounts for the exercise.

I attached a draft outline; Ben will follow up with technical prerequisites.

Regards,
Tessa Morgan
Senior Manager, Solutions Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachment: operator_sim_plan_v1.pdf (plan outline)
From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: tessa_morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Cc: vanessa_ortiz <vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai>, Kate Alvarez <kate@echelonhealth.com>, supply@procureops.com
Date: 2027-08-24T13:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: operator simulation window + acceptance criteria for staging validation

Tessa / Laura — quick technical notes to include in the runbook (drafted below). I put the steps in the order we'll execute during the 3-hour window. Please review and flag anything missing.

1) Pre-simulation prep (30m) — confirm operator MFA, SSH jumpbox access, KMS test key policies, network ACLs in staging, and ensure staging ELB is pinned to test certs.
2) KMS rotation (40m) — trigger key rotate via HSM API, validate service restart and KV cache rehydration, verify no token leakage in telemetry collector.
3) Offline patch delivery (35m) — simulate receiving patch bundle on USB/airlock host, apply patches to node group A, verify package signatures, and run smoke tests.
4) DB snapshot/restore (20m) — take DB snapshot, transfer via sanitized media, restore to staging replica, validate record counts and application checksum.
5) Failure-mode and rollback (25m) — simulate failed patch on node B, exercise rollback playbook, confirm operator escalation path and postmortem logging.
6) Acceptance verification (10m) — run staging-validation-checklist.xlsx; Laura will mark each control as pass/warn/fail.

Notes / prerequisite asks for Echelon: SSH jump host IP ranges, KMS HSM test credentials (or a temporary test key), and confirmation of staging snapshot retention for 48 hours post-run.

I will attach the network diagram and a first-pass checklist for Laura to map to controls.

—Ben
Principal On-prem Engineer

Attachment: redwood-onprem-network-diagram.png
From: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>

Subject: Re: Request: operator simulation window + acceptance criteria for staging validation

Thanks Ben — this looks good. A few additions for the checklist mapping to Echelon's controls:

- Operator separation: verify distinct operator accounts for maintenance vs backup restores; ensure no shared keys across operator roles.
- Egress gating: confirm telemetry endpoint is set to internal collector and simulate blocked egress to public internet (we'll run a connectivity test).
- Audit logging: ensure lift-and-shift of audit logs to secured storage; test log integrity (hash check) after the run.
- Time-stamped attestation: have operators sign the post-run attestation with timestamped evidence; we'll include a template attestation form in the checklist.

I'll take the XLSX and add a Control ID column (your SOC-2 references) and a Required Evidence column. Expected turnaround by 2027-09-01 EOD.

—Laura
Systems Reliability Lead
